slides.texte_overlay:
signs you're more emotionally
mature than people realise

you pause before reacting

when something upsets you, you take a breath before answering. that small pause gives your calm side time to speak first, and it saves you from saying things you'd regret.

you can hear criticism

you can listen to feedback without feeling attacked or rushing to defend yourself. taking what's useful and letting go of the rest is a quiet sign of real maturity.

you keep growing on purpose

emotionally mature people keep learning about the world and about themselves, a little every day. understanding more about how people and the world work makes patience much easier.
slides.texte_sophia:
you keep growing on purpose

i realised growing up never really stops. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, psychology or history, and understanding more makes me calmer with everyone.

slides.texte_overlay:
you don't need to win

you can let a small argument go without having the last word. choosing peace over being right shows you care more about the relationship than about your pride.

you own your mistakes

you can say i was wrong and mean it, without a long list of excuses. owning your mistakes cleanly makes people trust you far more than pretending you never make any.
